retired_requirements.reason: Compresses the lifecycle risk-management process, four mandatory process steps, residual-risk criteria, control hierarchy, testing duties, vulnerable-group consideration and sectoral integration rule into one article-level abstraction.

migration_notes: Article 9(3) is preserved as a scope qualification on the Article 9 risk propositions rather than as a synthetic standalone duty.
Article 9(7) is a permission concerning real-world testing, not a mandatory testing requirement.
For Article 6(1) systems, the 2026 Article 2(13) limitation mechanism may affect Articles 9-15 only where its statutory conditions and delegated-act mechanism are satisfied.

requirements.requirement_summary: Establish, implement, document and maintain a risk management system for each high-risk AI system.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Risk management system for a high-risk AI system
requirements.governance_expectation: Establish, implement, document and maintain the risk management system.
applicability_conditions: Applies to high-risk AI systems subject to Article 9.
exceptions_or_qualifications: For Article 6(1) systems, Article 2(13) may limit application only under its specified conditions and delegated-act mechanism.

requirements.requirement_summary: Plan and run risk management as a continuous iterative process throughout the high-risk AI system lifecycle, with regular systematic review and updating.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Risk management process for a high-risk AI system
requirements.governance_expectation: Operate risk management continuously and iteratively across the lifecycle and review and update it regularly and systematically.
applicability_conditions: Applies to high-risk AI systems subject to Article 9.
exceptions_or_qualifications: Article 9(3) limits Article 9 risks to those reasonably mitigable or eliminable through development/design or adequate technical information.

requirements.requirement_summary: Identify and analyse known and reasonably foreseeable health, safety and fundamental-rights risks arising when the high-risk AI system is used as intended.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Known and reasonably foreseeable risks of a high-risk AI system
requirements.governance_expectation: Identify and analyse known and reasonably foreseeable risks under intended use.
applicability_conditions: Applies to high-risk AI systems subject to Article 9.
exceptions_or_qualifications: Article 9(3) limits the Article 9 risk scope to risks reasonably mitigable or eliminable through development/design or adequate technical information.

requirements.requirement_summary: Estimate and evaluate risks that may emerge under intended use and reasonably foreseeable misuse.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Risks of a high-risk AI system
requirements.governance_expectation: Estimate and evaluate risk under intended use and reasonably foreseeable misuse.
applicability_conditions: Applies to high-risk AI systems subject to Article 9.
exceptions_or_qualifications: Article 9(3) limits the Article 9 risk scope to risks reasonably mitigable or eliminable through development/design or adequate technical information.

requirements.requirement_summary: Evaluate other risks that may arise based on analysis of data gathered through the Article 72 post-market monitoring system.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Risks identified from post-market monitoring data
requirements.governance_expectation: Feed post-market monitoring evidence back into risk evaluation.
evidence_expectation: Post-market monitoring data relevant to risk evaluation.
applicability_conditions: Applies to high-risk AI systems subject to Article 9.
exceptions_or_qualifications: Article 9(3) limits the Article 9 risk scope to risks reasonably mitigable or eliminable through development/design or adequate technical information.

requirements.requirement_summary: Adopt appropriate and targeted risk management measures addressing the risks identified under Article 9(2)(a).
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Risk management measures for a high-risk AI system
requirements.governance_expectation: Adopt measures targeted to the identified risks.
applicability_conditions: Applies to high-risk AI systems subject to Article 9.
exceptions_or_qualifications: Article 9(3) limits the Article 9 risk scope to risks reasonably mitigable or eliminable through development/design or adequate technical information.

requirements.requirement_summary: When selecting risk management measures, consider effects and interactions from the combined application of Section 2 requirements so risks are minimised effectively while implementation remains appropriately balanced.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Risk management measures and interacting Section 2 requirements
requirements.governance_expectation: Account for interactions among applicable high-risk-system requirements when selecting risk controls.

requirements.requirement_summary: Ensure the relevant residual risk associated with each hazard is judged acceptable.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Residual risk associated with each hazard
requirements.governance_expectation: Judge each hazard's relevant residual risk to be acceptable.
applicability_conditions: Applies to Article 9 risk management measures.

requirements.requirement_summary: Ensure the overall residual risk of the high-risk AI system is judged acceptable.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Overall residual risk of a high-risk AI system
requirements.governance_expectation: Judge the system's overall residual risk to be acceptable.
applicability_conditions: Applies to Article 9 risk management measures.

requirements.requirement_summary: Eliminate or reduce identified and evaluated risks as far as technically feasible through adequate design and development of the high-risk AI system.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Identified and evaluated risks of a high-risk AI system
requirements.governance_expectation: Prioritise technically feasible risk elimination or reduction through design and development.
exceptions_or_qualifications: Required as far as technically feasible.

requirements.requirement_summary: Where appropriate, implement adequate mitigation and control measures for risks that cannot be eliminated.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Risks that cannot be eliminated
requirements.governance_expectation: Apply adequate mitigation and controls to non-eliminable risks where appropriate.
exceptions_or_qualifications: Applies where appropriate and to risks that cannot be eliminated.

requirements.requirement_summary: Provide the information required by Article 13 and, where appropriate, training to deployers as part of risk management.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Information and training provided to deployers
requirements.governance_expectation: Use required information and appropriate deployer training as risk controls.

requirements.requirement_summary: When eliminating or reducing use-related risks, give due consideration to expected deployer technical knowledge, experience, education and training and the presumable context of use.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Risk controls addressing use-related risks
requirements.governance_expectation: Tailor use-related risk controls to reasonably expected deployer capability and context.

requirements.requirement_summary: Test the high-risk AI system to identify the most appropriate and targeted risk management measures.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: High-risk AI system
requirements.governance_expectation: Use testing to identify appropriate targeted risk controls.
evidence_expectation: Testing evidence supporting selection of risk management measures.

requirements.requirement_summary: Use testing to ensure the high-risk AI system performs consistently for its intended purpose.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: High-risk AI system performance
requirements.governance_expectation: Demonstrate consistent intended-purpose performance through testing.
evidence_expectation: Testing evidence of consistent intended-purpose performance.

requirements.requirement_summary: Use testing to ensure the high-risk AI system complies with the requirements in Chapter III Section 2.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: High-risk AI system compliance with Section 2
requirements.governance_expectation: Use testing to establish compliance with the applicable Section 2 requirements.
evidence_expectation: Testing evidence relevant to Section 2 compliance.

requirements.requirement_summary: Testing procedures may include testing in real-world conditions in accordance with Article 60.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Testing procedure for a high-risk AI system
requirements.governance_expectation: Real-world testing is permitted as part of testing procedures only in accordance with Article 60.
verification_method: Testing in real-world conditions where used
applicability_conditions: Article 60 conditions apply when real-world testing is used.
exceptions_or_qualifications: This is a permission, not a requirement to conduct real-world testing.

requirements.requirement_summary: Perform testing, as appropriate, at relevant times throughout the development process.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Testing of a high-risk AI system
requirements.governance_expectation: Test throughout development when appropriate.
timing_or_frequency: As appropriate throughout the development process.

requirements.requirement_summary: In all cases, perform testing before the high-risk AI system is placed on the market or put into service.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Testing of a high-risk AI system
requirements.governance_expectation: Complete required testing before market placement or putting into service.
timing_or_frequency: Before placing on the market or putting into service.

requirements.requirement_summary: Carry out testing against prior-defined metrics and probabilistic thresholds appropriate to the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Testing criteria for a high-risk AI system
requirements.governance_expectation: Define appropriate metrics and probabilistic thresholds before testing and test against them.
evidence_expectation: Prior-defined testing metrics and probabilistic thresholds.
verification_method: Testing against prior-defined metrics and probabilistic thresholds
exceptions_or_qualifications: Metrics and thresholds must be appropriate to intended purpose.

requirements.requirement_summary: When implementing the Article 9(1)-(7) risk management system, consider whether the intended-purpose use of the high-risk AI system is likely to adversely affect persons under 18 and, where appropriate, other vulnerable groups.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Risk management assessment of vulnerable-group impacts
requirements.governance_expectation: Consider adverse impacts on children and, as appropriate, other vulnerable groups in risk management.
applicability_conditions: Applies when implementing the Article 9(1)-(7) risk management system.
exceptions_or_qualifications: Other vulnerable groups are considered as appropriate.

requirements.requirement_summary: A provider already subject to internal risk-management requirements under other relevant Union law may include or combine Article 9(1)-(9) aspects within those existing risk-management procedures.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system subject to other Union-law internal risk-management requirements
governed_object: Risk management procedures
requirements.governance_expectation: Permit integration of Article 9 aspects into existing Union-law risk-management procedures without treating integration as displacement of the Article 9 aspects.
applicability_conditions: Provider is subject to internal risk-management-process requirements under other relevant Union law.
exceptions_or_qualifications: This permits integration or combination; it does not state that Article 9 aspects may be omitted.
